entries.text: H-hello! It’s me again, from the supply unit...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_01

entries.text: Blech... It drooled all over me. What even IS that\nPokémon anyway?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_05

entries.text: I have no idea what it is
entries.label: team_0050_select_02

entries.text: Errr, I guess that’s one word for it... Wait, is it\nreally that special?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_06a

entries.text: Huh? I’m amazed you’re so calm with a giant\nquestion mark of a Pokémon at your side...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_06b

entries.text: Ah, um, but before I forget... Here’s your reward.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_07

entries.text: Since you’re part of Operation Starfall’s battle\nunit, can I ask you something?\c\nWhat do you think of Team Star?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_09

entries.text: You know, some of the rumors say Team Star\nwasn’t always a bunch of delinquents.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_11

entries.text: Most of them used to be victims of bullying, or\nthey just found it hard to interact with people...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_12

entries.text: But then these misfits and outsiders found each\nother and banded together to form Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_13

entries.text: All they wanted to do was push back against the\nbullies they couldn’t face alone...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_14

entries.text: But, uh, that’s just info I got by hacking other\nstudents’ social media accounts.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_15

entries.text: I also found talk about some secret mastermind\nbehind the five bosses—someone who recruited\r\nthem to the team in the first place...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_16

entries.text: Hm. I don’t normally talk this much. Now my\nthroat kinda hurts...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0050_botan_17

entries.text: So, um, good luck—with taking down the other\nbases and stuff.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
